ringconstruction.title: Ring Construction
ringconstruction.description: This final ability allows you to create a duplicate of your current ring at the cost of all your compassion. Once used, the ability becomes locked. Note: You must have Compassion Max lvl 3

first_tick_commands: execute as @s anchored eyes positioned ^ ^ ^3 run function final_lanterns:indigolanternconstruction
